reviews.title: Dev Please Read 😪 Frustrating, Incomplete - Basically Useless Without Reusing Custom Lighting Scene
reviews.text:
This home automation control app has the potential to be a great tool but unfortunately it falls flat in the most basic and essential area: lighting control. Specifically, the lack of support for saving custom color animations makes the app almost useless for anyone looking for anything more than a tacky party light show. If you are trying to create a sophisticated lighting environment such as something calm, ambient, or elegant you are out of luck. The app seems designed solely for chaotic fast moving color blasts that look more like a rejected nightclub demo than a proper smart home lighting system.

Here is the problem. The developers clearly did not put much care into the included animation presets. They are jarring, overly saturated, and move so fast they are more likely to cause a headache than enhance a mood. There is no sense of refinement. None of the slow luxurious fades you would expect from premium LED installations like the subtle atmospheric lighting you might see on a Dreamliner aircraft. Instead it feels like someone threw together a few random color cycles in a rush and called it a day.

And that would not be the end of the world if the app let you create your own color schemes and save them. But it does not. You cannot save your own animations. You cannot even save a custom color scene across your devices. There is no way to replicate a look once you have created it. reviews.title: App confusing and clunky
reviews.text: Buttons don’t work, interface really unclear.  How complicated can controlling a panel heater be, ffs?

reviews.title: Limited functionality
reviews.text: It works fine but - for my Yaskyly weather station - the app only shows me the temperature. There is much more data on the weather station that the app could show - particularly pressure. The ability to integrate the app with SmartThings would also be useful.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: We have four home thermostats connected to the tuya app as we wanted to be able to control the thermostat remotely. However, it keeps automatically removing the devices and this happens on pretty much a weekly basis. Troubleshooting is impossible as it just gives you vague reasons for this happening, like loss of WiFi connection.

reviews.title: Too slow
reviews.text: Ring bell. App rings 30 seconds later. Wont connect to bell. Visitor leaves.

reviews.title: The app does not work
reviews.text: I only have one light bulb to try the system before I  buy more but the app and the light bulb do not talk to each other and I have to have the light bulb on all the time to execute a single command! Tried for days!! Waste of time and money!!

reviews.title: Ruined
reviews.text: Since last update I have only been able to connect twice. Whatever was done it’s made it very unstable and unusable

reviews.title: Persistent Location Requests
reviews.text: This review does not reflect the apps overall functionality as the app works as intended to allow control of various devices however this is focused on the fact that the app consistently keeps asking for your location to be enabled even though that is not necessary for most of the apps functions. I do not like the fact that this app essentially persists over and over again for you to enable location services even though I had denied that request several times. This needs to change ASAP. And if it does change I will update this review to reflect that.

reviews.title: Awful UX
reviews.text: This has to be me of the worst app experiences out there. Setting a program for hearing is unbelievably painful - literally the worst possible UX you could have chosen for this action. The automation and smart features don’t work. The card on the homepage doesn’t tell you if the thing is running or not. So far, absolutely pointless application other than to link to Alexa that does a better job.
